decisions.limits: States Go-authoritative backend with Python as spec-only; parity status of any specific module must be checked in code, not assumed from this ADR.
decisions.summary: Go is the authoritative edge backend; Python artifacts are specs and harnesses. Cross-language behavior is pinned by fixtures/golden_cases.json.
decisions.title: Go-first edge

decisions.limits: Covers architecture and test doubles; does not prove production behavior against live third-party systems.
decisions.summary: External evidence enters through ports/adapters with Mockoon doubles in tests; paise-int64 money handling at the boundary.
decisions.title: External evidence boundary

decisions.limits: Inventory table is a design-time record; runtime enforcement must be confirmed against the current agent code before claiming enforcement.
decisions.summary: Investigation agents are read-only: no APPROVE/DENY/PAY authority. Denied tool T11 documents the exact mutation boundary.
decisions.title: Agent mutation boundary

decisions.limits: Threshold value and placeholder policy verified in source text only; OCR pipeline pass rates need dated run evidence.
decisions.summary: OCRConfidence value object with inclusive IsLow(0.85) gate routes low-confidence documents to human review; placeholder 1.0 is never trusted.
decisions.title: OCR confidence HITL gate

evidence.env: CI ubuntu-latest (config verified; individual run links not yet recorded)
evidence.limits: Proves the gates exist and what they cover; does not by itself prove any single run passed — link dated runs before claiming passes.
evidence.scope: gofmt, go vet, live-secret guards, build-tag isolation, go test ./..., scoped -race, LiteParse live smoke (hard fail), pytest tests/unit, ruff, mypy strict, terraform validate

limitations: Groq qwen3 live-model qualification is In progress (manual gate, not CI) — do not present as qualified.
Parser corpus figures (45 cases etc.) are Tested at most until the v1 evaluation report and dated runs are verified.
Postgres/RLS and Mockoon contracts are emulator/CI-scoped; managed-cloud qualification is Blocked/Unqualified pending project and billing decisions.
No production deployment, business-outcome, or performance claims are supported by these records.
tagline: Health-insurance claims investigation with bounded AI reasoning and human oversight. The AI investigates; it never approves, denies, or pays.
verifiedBy: portfolio content audit (read-only webfetch of raw sources listed)
